You'll handle first and second-line incidents and service requests for about 450 of our colleagues, across our London office and those working remotely. This hands-on support role is all about keeping our end-user devices, Microsoft 365, and collaboration tools running smoothly while managing access requests in line with our service levels and escalation paths. We run a modern, cloud-managed estate (using Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, NinjaOne, and Freshservice) with absolutely no legacy, on-premises desktop systems. Because we're an automation-first team, you'll spend as much time using and improving automated workflows as you will fixing individual issues. Our people are technically capable, and they look to us for quick, smart support that's clearly explained. If you love finding solutions, exploring new ways to automate, and making technology seamless for everyone, you'll fit right in. We're here to support you as you learn, grow, and help us scale our modern workplace. Write and maintain knowledge base articles and runbooks so that recurring issues can be resolved at first contact, or by our colleagues themselves through self-service.
